notes: The first branch ends at «حدثنا سفيان» and the second at «قال حدثنا سفيان بن عيينة»; the names after the last «ح» (عمرو بن دينار، سمع طاوسا، يقول سمعت أبا هريرة) are written once and belong to both, so they are the shared tail
The two Sufyan surfaces are kept as written and not merged (rule 9)
«- المعنى -» is a gloss and is left out
«قال أحمد بن صالح عن عمرو عن طاوس سمع أبا هريرة» omits Sufyan ibn Uyayna: a variant remark, not a route of the saying
The Prophet ends the chain and is not written
